subject: Public Rust trusted-player-count endpoint and Steam GMS query boundaries

trustedCountEndpoint.shape: JSON object mapping game IP:port strings to integer counts

snapshots.comparison: A parallel request with Cache-Control:no-cache and Pragma:no-cache returned the same target, entry count, batch timestamp, Age and cache HIT. This did not obtain an uncached origin response. The map contained only the target game-port entry for this IP.

limitations: The service's backend count-generation algorithm has not been established.
A cache-control max-age header is not evidence that the data is generated only once per day.
Observed batch timestamps are not a guaranteed refresh schedule.
These observations do not prove that Steam gamesPlayed activity changes the count.

officialSteamEvidence.quote: When you are using Steam authentication system this call is never required, the auth system automatically sets the appropriate rich presence.
officialSteamEvidence.implication: Do not assume a separate AdvertiseGame call or manually supplied game-server address is required solely from missing rich-presence fields.
officialSteamEvidence.limitation: This documents Steam rich presence, not Facepunch trusted-count generation.

officialSteamEvidence.finding: A client issues an auth-session ticket; the receiver starts an auth session and receives a backend validation callback. A valid ticket also validates ownership for the AppID.
officialSteamEvidence.limitation: This does not document a Facepunch trusted-count algorithm or a gamesPlayed prerequisite.

officialSteamEvidence.quote: Asynchronously retrieves the total number of players currently playing the current game. Both online and in offline mode.
officialSteamEvidence.limitation: This is an app-wide count and cannot establish a per-server trusted count.

steamGmsImplementation.documentation: README serverQuery describes players as authenticated players and explains its use in limiting inflated Steam browser counts. This is third-party library documentation, not proof of Facepunch's backend implementation.

loadedSchemaInspection.method: Read the generated schema loader and inspect selected protobuf type metadata without creating or logging in a Steam client.
loadedSchemaInspection.mergeOrder: common.json is loaded before steammessages_clientserver_gameservers.json; mergeObjects replaces same-named properties with later definitions

wrapperBoundary.playersMapping: The public serverQuery wrapper maps server.auth_players to returned players.
wrapperBoundary.stalePortMapping: The same wrapper still reads server.server_port, which is absent from its actual loaded newer server type.
wrapperBoundary.staleIpMapping: The wrapper passes the server_ip message object to IPv4.intToString; that helper coerces its input with >>> 0 instead of reading server_ip.v4.
wrapperBoundary.diagnosticRequirement: Read selected original response fields and match game/query addresses explicitly; do not infer an exact endpoint from the wrapper's mapped port or IP.
wrapperBoundary.limitation: No authenticated GMS query or account connection was performed for this evidence file.

selectedResponseFields.addr: field 1, explicitly described as IP plus query port

otherSteamServerListInterfaces.limitation: A field called players is not by itself proof of authenticated-player semantics. Its value can be compared to a strictly matched ClientGMSServerQuery auth_players response, but no such comparison was executed by this researcher.

webApiPublicReference.description: Gets a list of servers given a filter string
webApiPublicReference.label: UNDOCUMENTED
webApiPublicReference.provenance: The mirror states that it is generated from GetSupportedAPIList using an API key.
webApiPublicReference.officialDocObservation: The public Steamworks page lists server-account management and IP/SteamID mapping methods, but no GetServerList section was present when inspected.
webApiPublicReference.limitation: No Web API key was accessed or used. Neither the mirror nor the inspected official page specifies player-count generation, freshness or Facepunch's choice of source.

steamDirectoryBoundary.finding: SteamKit SteamDirectory calls ISteamDirectory.GetCMListForConnect to discover Steam connection-manager endpoints. This is not a game-server player-count interface.

otherSteamServerListInterfaces.unresolved: No inspected public source establishes whether Facepunch playerCounts consumes the Web API GetServerList, CM auth_players, a different Steam source or an independent calculation.

officialBrowserHistory.quote: Tired of waiting 60+ sec for your favourite server to show up? Try enabling the "Use Cache" button & click "Refresh" to load all servers instantly!
officialBrowserHistory.historicalStatus: The announcement described it as experimental and disabled by default at that time.
officialBrowserHistory.limitation: This documents the existence of a cached browser in 2023, not the current trusted-count algorithm, cache lifetime or selected browser path.

publicPolicySearch.officialChangelogPagesInspected: https://rust.facepunch.com/changes pages 1 through 15, covering the current 2026 page back through July 2020
publicPolicySearch.finding: No trusted-player-count generation specification was found in these support search results or the inspected changelog entries. The documented cached browser is recorded separately above.
publicPolicySearch.limitation: A limited search is not evidence that no public specification exists.

privacy: Only public server-address/count observations and public implementation details are included. No credentials, account identifiers, tickets, tokens, private configuration or raw game payloads are included.
